en: Okay, so I just moved my entire life across the world to Berlin Germany.
zh: 好了，所以我刚刚把我的整个人生都搬到了世界另一端，搬到了德国柏林。

en: It's been a crazy phase of life.
zh: 这真的是人生中特别疯狂的一个阶段。

en: It's been scary.
zh: 它很吓人。

en: It's been lonely.
zh: 也很孤独。

en: I mean, my wife, Sophie, came with me, obviously.
zh: 我是说，我妻子 Sophie 当然是跟我一起来了。

en: Hold on. What's the angle?
zh: 等一下，这个角度怎么回事？

en: There we go.
zh: 好了，可以了。

en: Yeah, it's been a crazy phase of life.
zh: 对，这真的是人生中特别疯狂的一个阶段。

en: It's also been awesome at the same time.
zh: 但与此同时，它也特别棒。

en: If you can even have both of those things, I don't know.
zh: 如果这两种感觉真的能同时存在的话，我也不知道。

en: And I want to share why Berlin, Germany.
zh: 我想跟大家聊聊，为什么是德国柏林。

en: why uproot my life and move to a new country overseas.
zh: 为什么要连根拔起自己的生活，搬到海外一个新的国家。

en: And then I also want to share this crazy apartment.
zh: 然后我也想带大家看看这个很夸张的公寓。

en: I don't know if you noticed, this is like, whoa, hold on.
zh: 不知道你们有没有注意到，这里真的有点，哇，等一下。

en: I'm still here.
zh: 我还在这儿。

en: This is like the nicest apartment I've ever even been in in real life.
zh: 这大概是我现实生活中见过的最好的公寓了。

en: And we get to live here, which is crazy.
zh: 而且我们居然能住在这里，真的很疯狂。

en: It's my little desk setup area there.
zh: 那边是我的小书桌区域。

en: We got super lucky and couldn't pass up this opportunity.
zh: 我们真的超级幸运，没办法错过这个机会。

en: So I really want to share the apartment as well.
zh: 所以我也特别想跟大家分享一下这个公寓。

en: We'll do like a little little scope session.
zh: 我们会简单带大家逛一小圈。

en: I was living on the west coast of Canada on Vancouver Island,
zh: 我之前住在加拿大西海岸的温哥华岛，

en: kind of considered one of the nicest places in the world to live.
zh: 那里算是世界上最适合居住的地方之一。

en: Good job by the ocean.
zh: 有不错的工作，靠着海。

en: Amazing climate. Good friends.
zh: 气候很棒，也有很好的朋友。

en: But to be honest, I just felt too comfortable.
zh: 但说实话，我就是觉得自己过得太舒服了。

en: I realize that sounds a bit silly, but I was so stuck in my routine,
zh: 我知道这听起来有点傻，但我真的被困在了自己的日常里，

en: my ways after so many years of living there.
zh: 被困在多年住在那里形成的生活方式里。

en: I just felt like I was watching the days go by.
zh: 我感觉自己只是在看着日子一天天过去。

en: It kind of felt like there was nothing spicy about it.
zh: 感觉生活里好像没什么刺激的东西。

en: And I missed some adventure, some spiciness.
zh: 我怀念那种冒险感，那种带点刺激的感觉。

en: Guess that's why we decided to move to Berlin, Germany.
zh: 我想这就是我们决定搬到德国柏林的原因吧。

en: My wife is from Germany, so it kind of felt like a good decision.
zh: 我妻子是德国人，所以这感觉也算是个不错的决定。

en: And Berlin is a city full of art and culture and inspiration.
zh: 而且柏林是一座充满艺术、文化和灵感的城市。

en: I left all my belongings behind.
zh: 我把所有家当都留在了原地。

en: and put everything into two suitcases, which was basically just clothes and like some camera gear.
zh: 只把所有东西塞进了两个行李箱，基本上就是衣服和一些相机设备。

en: which was crazy as well, by the way, because.
zh: 顺便说一下，这件事本身也挺疯狂的，因为。

en: I was finding all these things that I've just accumulated over the years of living in Canada.
zh: 我发现了好多这些年住在加拿大时一点点攒下来的东西。

en: And I wasn't even really using those things.
zh: 而且那些东西我其实根本没怎么用。

en: And you're kind of wondering like.
zh: 然后你就会有点开始想，

en: what am I doing with all this stuff here?
zh: 我到底留着这么多东西干嘛呢？

en: You know, and then you go to this new country.
zh: 你知道吗，然后你去了一个新的国家。

en: your friends aren't here.
zh: 你的朋友都不在这里。

en: The version of you that everyone knows is gone.
zh: 大家熟悉的那个版本的你已经消失了。

en: And you're just left with yourself in this new city, this new country
zh: 你只剩下自己，待在这座新的城市、这个新的国家里，

en: where no one even knows who you are.
zh: 这里甚至没人知道你是谁。

en: No one knows you exist.
zh: 没人知道你的存在。

en: So I've been having to kind of like reinvent myself, which is I know it's cliche,
zh: 所以我有点不得不重新塑造自己，我知道这话很老套，

en: but I feel like so alive.
zh: 但我真的感觉自己特别鲜活。

en: I can't even put it into words.
zh: 我甚至无法用语言形容。

en: It feels so scary and foreign and like lonely.
zh: 这种感觉很吓人，很陌生，也很孤独。

en: And I miss my family and friends.
zh: 我也想念我的家人和朋友。

en: but also it feels so exciting and alive.
zh: 但同时，它又让人觉得特别兴奋，特别有生命力。

en: And everything is so new that I've just been so in the moment,
zh: 而且一切都太新了，所以我一直特别活在当下，

en: like every single day I feel alive.
zh: 几乎每一天我都觉得自己活得很真切。

en: Like I'm just happy to wake up and be existing.
zh: 就好像我只是醒来，意识到自己存在着，就已经很开心了。

en: To me, it's been like an incredible experience so far.
zh: 对我来说，到目前为止，这一直是一次很不可思议的经历。

en: And it kind of has brought me closer to myself.
zh: 而且它某种程度上让我离自己更近了。

en: been asking some deep questions and like.
zh: 我一直在问自己一些很深层的问题，像是。

en: journaling a lot, writing in like a bunch of different journals.
zh: 写了很多日记，写在各种不同的本子里。

en: witnessing how people live across the world is very cool.
zh: 亲眼看到世界另一端的人们是怎么生活的，这真的很酷。

en: Everyone has their own perspective and style of life.
zh: 每个人都有自己的视角和生活方式。

en: And the culture, of course, is different, which is kind of neat.
zh: 当然，文化也不一样，这一点也挺有意思的。

en: Like it's been very reflective and philosophical.
zh: 整个过程真的很让人反思，也很有哲学感。

en: OK, do you guys want to see the apartment now?
zh: 好了，你们现在想看看公寓吗？

en: I'm going to show you what this place looks like.
zh: 我来给你们看看这个地方长什么样。

en: This is kind of tricky.
zh: 这个有点不好拍。

en: So this is my little desk here.
zh: 所以这是我的小书桌。

en: I got a standing desk so I can raise it up and down.
zh: 我买了一张升降桌，可以升高也可以降下来。

en: That's important for your health and your back.
zh: 这对你的健康和后背都很重要。

en: Yeah, we're big into flowers.
zh: 对，我们真的很喜欢花。

en: So look, my wife, Sophie, got me some flowers.
zh: 所以你看，我妻子 Sophie 给我买了一些花。

en: Oh, I had to put them down because they're really heavy.
zh: 哦，我得把它们放下，因为真的很重。

en: We'll just put those there.
zh: 我们就把它们放那儿吧。

en: This is going to be like the work room.
zh: 这里会变成一个工作房间。

en: It's got these amazing, would you call that herringbone floor?
zh: 这里有这种很棒的，你会叫它人字拼地板吗？

en: It's beautiful. And there's like these big windows that I have the curtains down,
zh: 很漂亮。这里还有这些大窗户，不过我把窗帘放下来了，

en: which is really cool.
zh: 真的很酷。

en: And then as you go in here, we kind of set up.
zh: 然后你走进这里，我们大概是这样布置的。

en: This is the living room.
zh: 这里是客厅。

en: We got a bunch of used furniture.
zh: 我们买了很多二手家具。

en: We don't really buy new stuff, to be honest.
zh: 说实话，我们不太买全新的东西。

en: because it's good for the environment and you can save some money.
zh: 因为这样对环境更好，而且还能省点钱。

en: Really nice space.
zh: 空间真的很不错。

en: We've got an epic balcony, which I am so mind blown about,
zh: 我们还有一个超绝的阳台，我真的被它震惊到了，

en: really excited for.
zh: 也特别期待。

en: We can get in a lot of plants, kind of helping create a nice little vibe.
zh: 我们可以放很多植物，慢慢营造出一个很舒服的小氛围。

en: This is easily my favorite part of the apartment.
zh: 这绝对是整个公寓里我最喜欢的部分。

en: This classic Berlin balcony up in the trees.
zh: 这个经典的柏林阳台，就藏在树丛之间。

en: The view is like crazy this way and the view is pretty crazy that way.
zh: 往这个方向看的景色很夸张，往那个方向看也很夸张。

en: You got to make sure you don't die, fall off, of course.
zh: 当然，你得确保自己别摔下去摔死。

en: But we're up in the trees.
zh: 但我们真的是在树丛上方。

en: We hear the birds chirping like pretty much all day.
zh: 我们几乎一整天都能听到鸟叫。

en: So it gives like a little bit of a nature vibe while being in the city,
zh: 所以即使住在城市里，它也有一点自然的感觉，

en: which is extra cool.
zh: 这就更酷了。

en: I've never had a balcony anywhere that I've ever lived before.
zh: 我以前住过的任何地方都从来没有过阳台。

en: So I'm like freaking out about this every time I see it.
zh: 所以我每次看到它都会有点激动到不行。

en: I spend a lot of time here, like writing, having a drink in the evening,
zh: 我会在这里待很久，比如写东西，晚上喝一杯，

en: or even my coffee in the morning.
zh: 或者早上在这里喝咖啡。

en: I almost just died.
zh: 我刚才差点死了。

en: I can't believe how sick that balcony is.
zh: 我真的不敢相信那个阳台有多绝。

en: That is, that is so sick.
zh: 那真的是，真的是太绝了。

en: This is the kitchen, which is also pretty sick.
zh: 这是厨房，也特别棒。

en: Never had such a nice kitchen before.
zh: 我以前从来没有过这么好的厨房。

en: so kind of freaking out about that.
zh: 所以我也有点为这个激动到不行。

en: Yeah, nice little courtyard thing in the back.
zh: 对，后面还有一个挺不错的小庭院之类的地方。

en: Do your little cooking here.
zh: 你可以在这里做点小饭。

en: So these Berlin apartments are really cool.
zh: 所以这些柏林公寓真的很酷。

en: They always have these like little courtyards in the back, behind.
zh: 它们后面通常都会有这种小庭院，在楼后面。

en: where everyone locks their bikes.
zh: 大家会在那里锁自行车。

en: There's like garbage and recycling back there.
zh: 后面也有垃圾和回收的地方。

en: So it's kind of like an inner little courtyard.
zh: 所以它有点像一个内部的小庭院。

en: And then we're lucky enough to have windows on both sides.
zh: 而且我们很幸运，两边都有窗户。

en: So that way in the morning we get sun in here.
zh: 这样早上的时候，这边就会有阳光照进来。

en: So that's why I put a little chair right there to have a little coffee in the morning.
zh: 所以我才在那里放了一把小椅子，早上可以坐着喝杯咖啡。

en: And then in the afternoon we get sun on the other side,
zh: 然后下午的时候，阳光会照到另一边，

en: which is southwest facing.
zh: 那边是朝西南的。

en: You know how I said I came here with only two suitcases?
zh: 你们还记得我说我只带了两个行李箱来这里吗？

en: So I had to like really choose the most important things to bring with me.
zh: 所以我真的必须挑最重要的东西带过来。

en: Leave everything else behind.
zh: 其他所有东西都得留下。

en: Well, for some reason the thought of having some of my Star Wars Lego,
zh: 但不知道为什么，一想到能带一点我的 Star Wars 乐高，

en: just like a few pieces, you know?
zh: 就几件而已，你懂吧？

en: And I was like, oh yeah.
zh: 然后我就想，哦对。

en: if I have my Lego Star Wars ship there, I'll just feel like I'm at home.
zh: 如果我的 Lego Star Wars 飞船在那里，我就会感觉像在家一样。

en: Like I'm cozy.
zh: 感觉很安心。

en: I got my Star Wars Lego.
zh: 我有我的 Star Wars 乐高。

en: Everything is good.
zh: 一切就都好了。

en: I do realize I sound like I'm 10 years old right now,
zh: 我知道我现在听起来像个 10 岁小孩，

en: but yeah, I don't care.
zh: 但没关系，我不在乎。

en: Lego is awesome.
zh: 乐高就是很棒。

en: Do you want to see the bedroom?
zh: 你们想看看卧室吗？

en: I don't know I'll show you the bedroom.
zh: 不知道，那我给你们看看卧室吧。

en: So that is the bedroom there.
zh: 所以那边就是卧室。

en: And you can kind of see from here all the way down into the living room,
zh: 而且你从这里能一路看到客厅那边，

en: which is crazy.
zh: 这真的很夸张。

en: So if you come in here.
zh: 所以如果你走进这里。

en: this is our beautiful coat rack here, just in the hallway.
zh: 这是我们漂亮的衣帽架，就在走廊这里。

en: where we can hang our coats and make our cool fits before we leave.
zh: 我们可以把外套挂在这里，出门前搭配好我们的酷穿搭。

en: Okay, so the front door is right behind you guys.
zh: 好了，所以大门就在你们身后。

en: This is the front hallway area.
zh: 这里是玄关区域。

en: Nice and spacious.
zh: 很舒服，也很宽敞。

en: Okay, so that's the apartment.
zh: 好了，这就是这个公寓。

en: You can see why I'm so stoked to be here.
zh: 你们能看出来我为什么这么兴奋能住在这里。

en: especially coming from North America.
zh: 尤其是从北美搬过来之后。

en: We don't really have apartments like this back home.
zh: 我们老家那边真的不太有这样的公寓。

en: Incredibly thankful that my wife Sophie and I get to live here in this place.
zh: 我真的非常感激，我和妻子 Sophie 能住在这个地方。

en: And I've always felt that way about traveling and moving to a new country.
zh: 而我对旅行和搬到一个新国家这件事，一直都是这种感觉。

en: I see it as like a very privileged thing.
zh: 我觉得这是一件非常幸运、非常有特权的事情。

en: And we were lucky enough to like not have too big of responsibilities stuck in Canada
zh: 而且我们也很幸运，在加拿大没有太多会把我们困住的重大责任，

en: that we were able to move here.
zh: 所以我们才能搬到这里。

en: If you have the opportunity to go live in another country and try out a different lifestyle and culture,
zh: 如果你有机会去另一个国家生活，尝试一种不同的生活方式和文化，

en: it's such a cool opportunity in my opinion.
zh: 在我看来，那真的是一个特别酷的机会。

en: getting inspired for art or projects or just building a new lifestyle.
zh: 无论是为艺术或项目寻找灵感，还是只是建立一种新的生活方式。

en: Like I don't want to sugarcoat everything.
zh: 我也不想把一切都美化。

en: I've been lonely.
zh: 我也一直很孤独。

en: I've been terrified of like the unpredictable future or whatever.
zh: 我也会害怕那种不可预测的未来，或者类似的东西。

en: and making new friends.
zh: 还有重新交朋友这件事。

en: And like it's been hard.
zh: 而且它确实很难。

en: It's definitely been hard.
zh: 它绝对很难。

en: But by creating some distance from my old life in Canada.
zh: 但通过和我在加拿大的旧生活拉开一些距离。

en: really helping me figure out what's important to me and like who I want to be
zh: 这真的在帮助我弄清楚什么对我来说重要，以及我想成为怎样的人。

en: while resetting everything here.
zh: 同时在这里把一切重新开始。

en: which is pretty powerful in my opinion.
zh: 在我看来，这其实挺有力量的。

en: I'm I'm so grateful and happy to be moving to Berlin.
zh: 我真的非常感激，也很开心自己搬到了柏林。

en: It's very cool.
zh: 这真的很酷。

en: Yeah, we'll see how this adventure goes.
zh: 对，我们就看看这场冒险会怎么发展吧。

en: You can expect a lot more videos from me here.
zh: 之后你们可以期待我在这里拍更多视频。

en: And thanks for watching and I'll see you around Peace.
zh: 感谢观看，我们之后再见，Peace。
